title: 第9章 女二号！
slug: 我在致郁番里画热血番
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这猛然间的提示，让贺舟一下精神了。

剧情点？

这是什么意思？

足够的人气值他是能理解的，可是剧情点？

如果说是自己参与的剧情的话，上一次的剧情为什么没有给剧情点？

两者的区别又是什么呢？

贺舟目光在落到江黛身上时，看她迷迷糊糊趴着睡觉，跟田园猫一样闲适的趴在桌上，睡得香甜的样子，忽然有了想法。

上次的剧情应该也是这狗作者安排的。

估计是以植入一个意念的方式来安排，如果符合人物调性，她们就会接受。

如果不符合人物调性她们就会拒绝。

“嘿，哥们。”

贺舟为了确定这件事，特地坐了过去，对上路安平静的眼神，呲牙笑：“你上周五晚上在干嘛？”

“在聆听。”

“说人话。”

“在家静静等待命运对我的安排。”

路安身体往后一仰：“可惜，命运依旧没有想起我。”

那忧郁仰头的模样，让贺舟嘴角都抽了一下。

很少见到比自己还能装的。

把等死说得这么清新脱俗。

所以上周他没出门。

这只小猫来找的是自己。

自己进入了剧情，加了人气却没加剧情点。

那这次呢？

这次为什么加了剧情点？

贺舟脑瓜子转了一下，福至心灵地很快就明白了。

对了，是刚刚。

自己一个NPC人物，终于被作者想起来了安排剧情了，这是一个主动行为，所以加了剧情点。

那升级为主角呢？

贺舟内心隐隐觉得，按照漫画的逻辑来思考的话，升级主角应该不止是这么简单的事。

一本漫画的主角，除了漫画作者给他安排最多的剧情，拥有最高的人气之外，还得有什么？

以后就知道了。

“角色会随着心意选择接受这个意念安排，以及根据性格拒绝拒绝，如果是这样的话…”

“只要把这只奶牛猫养熟了，让她只想跟我在一起不就好了。”

“那狗作者不想安排也得安排，由不得她了。”

贺舟内心信心十足。

主动权这不就来了吗！

不管做什么事！

主动权当然要主动握在自己手里！

贺舟准备舒服地混过今天的语文数学这样的常识课，毕竟这些东西自己都学过。

虽然以前觉得都还给老师了。

Page (1/3)

This sudden reminder made He Zhou perk up.

Plot point?

What does this mean?

He could understand it if it was popular enough, but what about the plot point?

If you were involved in the plot, why wasn't there any plot points in the last plot?

What is the difference between the two?

When He Zhou's eyes fell on Jiang Dai, he saw her sleeping on her stomach, lying on the table as leisurely as a garden cat, sleeping soundly, and suddenly he had an idea.

The plot last time was probably arranged by this dog author.

It is probably arranged in a way that implants an idea. If it fits the character's tonality, they will accept it.

If it doesn't fit the character, they will reject it.

"Hey, man."

In order to confirm this, He Zhou sat over and looked into Lu An's calm eyes, grinning: "What were you doing last Friday night?"

"Listening."

"Speak humanly."

"Quietly waiting at home for what fate has in store for me."

Lu An leaned back: "It's a pity that fate still doesn't think of me."

The melancholy look on his head made He Zhou's mouth twitch.

It’s rare to see someone who can pretend better than myself.

Waiting to die is so fresh and refined.

So he didn't go out last week.

This kitten is looking for you.

I entered the plot myself, adding popularity but not adding plot points.

What about this time?

Why did you add a plot point this time?

He Zhou's mind turned around, and Fu Zhi quickly understood in his heart.

By the way, just now.

As an NPC character, the author finally thought of arranging the plot. This was an active act, so plot points were added.

What about being promoted to a protagonist?

He Zhou vaguely felt that if he thought according to the logic of comics, upgrading the protagonist should be more than such a simple matter.

The protagonist of a comic book, apart from the comic author arranging the most plots for him and having the highest popularity, what else should he have?

You’ll find out later.

"The character will choose to accept this arrangement according to his heart, and refuse to refuse according to his character. If this is the case..."

"As long as we raise this cow cat to maturity, it will be fine if she only wants to be with me."

"Then the author has to make arrangements even if he doesn't want to. It's not up to her."

He Zhou was full of confidence.

Isn’t it time to take the initiative?

No matter what you do!

Of course, you must take the initiative and take the initiative in your own hands!

He Zhou was prepared to comfortably pass today's general knowledge classes such as Chinese and Mathematics. After all, he had learned these things himself.

Although I used to feel that I had to give it back to the teacher.
